title: RickySHD's Vanilla Vision
description: A beautiful and optimized Vanilla experience — refined, alive and creators-ready.
body:
![RickySHD's Vanilla Vision Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4fe4c8130fbd12ba2a4f058f6f9a716e252aa58a.png)

RickySHD's **Vanilla Vision** is a performance-friendly enhancement modpack that preserves the true Minecraft feeling while delivering deeper immersion, numerous fixes, and quality-of-life improvements. 
Every mod has been carefully selected to enhance lighting, atmosphere, and smoothness — all without breaking world compatibility or FPS stability.

## 🌍 Who is this pack for?
This modpack is for you if:
- you love **exploring** — thanks to [**Distant Horizons**](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) and [**Visual Effects+**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/visual-effects-plus) your world will feel vast and alive.
- you enjoy **building** — use [**Litematica**](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) to construct exactly what you want, how you want.
- you're a **content creator** — create cinematic timelapses and thumbnails with [**Flashback**](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback)'s powerful recording and in-game editing tools.


## 🔧 Manual Tweaks
Depending on your setup, various mods and resource packs can be disabled to further improve performance. Below is a list of common adjustments, ordered by their **impact on performance**:  
- (🔺High) **Distant Horizons**'s rendering can be disabled or tuned down to reduce CPU load. Alternatively, leave it running while AFK to pre-generate all LODs.
- (🔺High) **Iris Shader** are GPU-intensive and disabled by default. Some shaders may also have compatibility issues with other resources.
- (🔸Medium) **Fresh Animations** may cause stuttering on low-end PCs when many mobs are on screen; disable if necessary.
- (🔹Low) **Flashback Recording** can be resource-heavy during long sessions; disable if you're not using it frequently.

## 🪲 Known Issues
Sodium might show an "incompatible resource pack" warning when using [**ReShaded**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/re-shaded) after adding, removing, Despite this they're fully compatible, something's just broken on either end.
> ![Sodium's incompatible resource pack warning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/001a6dc103295e43d5d415931d4182919b628423.png)

[**Essential**](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential)'s menus and GUIs might be purple when using certain resource packs.
> ![Essential Mod's purple menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3ab04c056b75eb1695d9515a8f1df85f0253d49.png)
